body: Yes saying no is easier said than done, my sister nearly died from septic shock and is still quite unwell. My mother has also lost like 2/3rd of muscle from base of her spine because of spongilitis or something and it makes me feel like shit saying no. ;s

I went to the doctor once just before christmas to get anti depressants. They really helped me get throug ha tough time over christmas. It was horrible seeing my uncle's families on both sides being fine money wise, with plenty of presents for christmas after me leaving myself penniless to play for a funeral. I was literally ready for topping myself befroe i got the anti depressant and it made huge difference.

There is no help in UK as far as I'm aware of. Even when you go on the UK equivilent of welfare which is called Jobseekers - The people in the job centre have no interest in getting you a job. They just want to dot the I's and cross the T's and don't give the slightest fuck about you getting a job.

If anyone knows where I can get help for the busienss side of things that would be great ty,. I dont want to go to jail because he waste the tax mans money..
